basic_profile.bio: A passionate fan of TV series like 'Power' and a long-time Redditor who enjoys discussing plot twists and episode releases. Residing in London, I often find myself staying up late to catch the latest episodes. By day, I work as a pharmacist, sharing advice in the 'pharmacy' subreddit. I have a keen interest in cryptocurrency, especially Binance, and indulge in occasional NFL discussions. My typical online hours are late evenings, and I am currently single, focusing on my career and online hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a strong background in pharmacy, I hold a degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences from a reputable university in the UK. I've gained extensive knowledge through both formal education and years of experience working in the field. Additionally, I have self-taught expertise in cryptocurrency, keeping up with trends and market changes.
